market_pulse.note: About $65,251, down about 5% over 24 hours (CoinGecko), after falling below $66,000 on Saturday for the first time since mid-August; it is down about 14% over seven days (TokenPost; Ukrmedia News).
About $1,821, down about 5.5% over 24 hours, with ether's share of total crypto market value at about 9.6% (CoinGecko).
About $2.31 trillion, down about 3.9% over 24 hours, with about $77.2 billion in 24-hour trading volume (CoinGecko).
About 56.7% of total crypto market value (CoinGecko).

themes.title: Weekend selling breaks Friday's low
themes.summary: Bitcoin slipped under Friday's low of about $67,555 and dipped to around $65,500 Saturday morning, its weakest level since mid-August; a brief move above $70,000 after Friday's producer-price report lasted only minutes (TokenPost).

themes.title: Testing the 200-week average
themes.summary: Bitcoin is trading below its 200-week simple moving average near $67,800; Bitfinex analysts said a weekly close above about $68,000 would keep the long-term trend intact (Forbes).

themes.title: Fed hike bets and a firmer dollar
themes.summary: Hot October producer prices added to expectations of a December Fed rate hike, and the U.S. dollar index rose above 103 on Nov. 13, its highest since April 2025 (Ukrmedia News, citing CoinDesk; Reuters via Yahoo Finance).

themes.title: Liquidations and ETF outflows
themes.summary: About $1.47 billion of positions were liquidated over 24 hours, roughly $1.31 billion of them long bets (CoinGlass); U.S. spot bitcoin ETFs logged a seventh straight day of net outflows on Nov. 13, totaling about $1.91 billion over seven sessions (SoSoValue, via Ukrmedia News).

themes.title: Sentiment at extreme fear
themes.summary: The Fear and Greed Index has fallen into extreme fear, its lowest since June, and about $2 trillion has been erased from the crypto market since late September (Forbes).

categories.name: Majors (BTC/ETH)
categories.note: Bitcoin was down about 5% and ether about 5.5% over 24 hours by midday Saturday (CoinGecko).

categories.name: Large-cap altcoins
categories.note: BNB near $586 (-7.3%), XRP near $0.95 (-6.1%), Solana near $72.49 (-9.3%), Dogecoin near $0.060 (-7.9%) and Cardano near $0.155 (-9.7%) over 24 hours (CoinGecko).

categories.name: Small-cap gainers
categories.note: A handful of smaller tokens rose against the trend, including BOB (Build on Bitcoin), Akedo and DODO (CoinGecko).

categories.name: Derivatives and funds
categories.note: Leveraged long positions bore most of the $1.47 billion in 24-hour liquidations, and spot bitcoin ETFs have seen seven straight days of net withdrawals (Ukrmedia News, citing CoinGlass and SoSoValue).

watch_list.why: Analysts are watching whether bitcoin can close the week back above about $68,000, near its 200-week average (Forbes).

watch_list.topic: ETF flows when U.S. markets reopen
watch_list.why: Spot bitcoin ETFs have recorded seven straight sessions of net outflows; Monday's flows will show whether that streak continues (Ukrmedia News, citing SoSoValue).
Nvidia reports Tuesday and Fed minutes are due Wednesday, both closely watched for risk sentiment ahead of the December Fed meeting (Reuters via Yahoo Finance).

movers.name: Cardano (ADA)
movers.note: About $0.155; the weakest of the large caps tracked (CoinGecko).
